body.title: feat: implement DROP TABLE and verify storage wipe logic
body.body: ## 🚀 OSCG'26 Contributor Notice **NexumDB participates in the Open Source Contributor Games 2026!** High-quality PRs earn you points, recognition, and networking opportunities. Please follow our [contribution guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for maximum impact and ensure your submission meets OSCG quality standards. ## Summary I was assigned the DROP TABLE task and found that the core implementation was already present in the source. I have taken ownership of the Validation Phase by: - Developing and passing test_verify_physical_deletion to confirm the storage engine actually purges data. - Resolving critical Windows/Python 3.13 build issues that were preventing the project from compiling. -…
